message.content: {"summary":"You produced a solid SSO mission for GBR reef monitoring with clear STK evidence. You justified a single spacecraft, CSIRO/BOM users, Guiana launch on Vega E, 600km/97.79deg SSO, Mount Pleasant contacts and 5-year EOL with drag sail. Well-structured work, limited by launch source credibility and missing propulsion/deorbit analysis.","next_steps":["Replace Wikipedia timeline with ESA/Arianespace primary sources and validate Vega E availability; assess Vega C backup with orbit-matching constraints.","Correct orbital mechanics: show full Keplerian set with true anomaly, and clarify RAAN is inertial, not launch latitude. Size drag sail and show deorbit <25yr with delta-v/drag budget.","Upgrade referencing format and strengthen literature support for fluid-lensing requirements and SSO lighting rationale."],"criteria":{"C1":"You clearly defined primary mission for coral reef fluid-lensing monitoring, rationale on bleaching and GBR value, and justified single satellite simplicity. Users CSIRO/BOM identified well. To reach top of Accomplished, add detailed payload requirements and peer-reviewed references instead of URLs.","C2":"You provided launch (Vega E, Guiana), 600km/97.7924° SSO, a=6971km, ground station Mount Pleasant with access stats and STK Figures like Image 4. For higher Accomplished, fix RAAN interpretation, justify launch vehicle with primary sources, and add calculations for manoeuvres and drag-sail EOL.","C3":"Your conclusion summarises launch, polar SSO for illumination, ground station trade and Vega C contingency linked to bleaching need. To strengthen, synthesize quantitative results from orbit access and duration analysis and state explicit outcomes rather than general statements.","C4":"Clear engineering structure with Executive Summary, contents, labelled STK 3D views and access tables, readable writing. To reach top of Accomplished, use consistent citation style throughout, replace Wikipedia/NOAA URLs with academic sources, and ensure reference list matches in-text citations."}}
